title: Oswald Fiddlebender is a tutor chassis, and three builders aim it at three different artifacts
summary: Oswald sacrifices an artifact to put one costing exactly one more onto the battlefield, so a mono-white deck gets to pick its real win condition from the library each game. One primer climbs from two-drops to Monument to Endurance, then copies it, because each copy can make every opponent lose 3 life once a turn off a discard. An unrelated build climbs one step further to Giggling Skitterspike and grows it with Modular counters. The cEDH Decklist Database's Brewer's Corner lists a third, competitive route that chains into Marvin, Murderous Mimic and Pili-Pala for combo turns 3-4. Same commander, three payloads that share little beyond the chain.

notes: The Monument primer is long-form and still maintained (updated 2026-09-23, about 8,700 views): it gives a turn-by-turn opening, what to tutor first depending on whether a discard outlet is already down, and the damage maths once the Monument is copied.
The Monument primer reports its own play experience - consistent in multiplayer, strong in Two-Headed Giant, weak to repeat games against people who learn to exile the Monument - but no game logs.
The Skitterspike build is an independent author and a different payload: a four-drop reached one sacrifice later, with a Modular and counter-doubling package feeding it.

The cEDH Decklist Database lists Oswald in the Brewer's Corner (entry dated 2026-08-19), describing a toolbox that dumps artifacts early and breaks parity on stax like Trinisphere. Its decklists are on Moxfield and were not opened.
Range is the case for filing: the chain is the constant and the top of it is a deckbuilding choice, which is the several-shells shape the bar asks for.

alternatives.name: Monument to Endurance as the payload
alternatives.reason: A three-drop reached from any two-drop artifact; free discard creatures and copies of the Monument turn it into a burn clock.

alternatives.name: Giggling Skitterspike as the payload
alternatives.reason: An indestructible four-drop that deals its power to each opponent whenever it attacks, blocks or is targeted, grown by Modular creatures dying around it.

alternatives.name: Marvin and Pili-Pala combo
alternatives.reason: The competitive route: Marvin copies Oswald's ability, and the chain assembles a combo while the deck plays under its own stax.
